failure.symptom: Black through 18000 fields; no custom-loader disk DMA; frame task still advances.
failure.cause: Both CIA TOD counters remain stopped at zero. The loader polls CIAB TOD for a 235-scanline settling deadline; its difference remains -235 and its coroutine yields every field.
failure.evidence: Observational frozen-engine probe: old CopperStart CIAA/CIAB stopped at zero at fields 200,400,600,800; native control running; final ROM running.
failure.fix: Native cold startup clears CRB7 for counter writes, writes high/middle/low TOD bytes and starts both counters on the low-byte write. Timer/interrupt policy otherwise unchanged. No new guest caller checks or title recognition.

diagnosticLimits: TOD probe reads state by reflection without writes or injected CPU/RAM state. Initial ZIP-only launches were rejected before any emulation because macOS metadata has a second .adf-suffixed entry; final launches explicitly select DESiRE-InsideTheMachine.adf. Those starts are not game failures or passing replays.
scope: Sampled native compatibility only; no frame-by-frame hardware correctness, complete continuous audio fidelity, alternate platform/HD executable or throughput acceptance. No engine/CPU changes, host OS shims or publication.
